fr_html: Il se place au point de vue des faibles: ce sont eux qui ont besoin de la Cour; on ne peut les priver du moyen d'obtenir justice contre les forts qui se refusent à la leur accorder.
en_html: He considered the question from the point of view of the weak. They are the ones who need the Court. They must not be deprived of the means of obtaining justice against the strong who refuse to grant it to them.
